title: PAINLESS ACTIVATION STEERING: AN AUTOMATED, LIGHTWEIGHT APPROACH FOR POST-TRAINING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks and evaluates model performance on categories related to 'Morality' (including sub-categories of Deontology, Justice, and Commonsense) and 'Religion' (as a specific task within its bias evaluation suite). It measures the 'causal steering effect' on these specific ethical and belief-related dimensions.
